svg.title: Namu AI language atlas: all 836 Linguist catalog entries
svg.desc: Every pinned catalog entry is named individually. Colors follow Linguist metadata when available, otherwise classification. These are metadata reference fixtures, not executable implementations. Native GitHub statistics may combine parent groups.
svg.text: 836 catalog entries · 754 potential parent groups · no “Other” category in this atlas
Detailed metadata references. No claim of compiled programs or installed support in every language. Zoom in to explore.
